candidate: M3/M4 all-task E2 route-cover lower-bound prototype; first projection proof only
hypothesis: A route-cover relaxation with delivery AND pickup tasks, variable load profiles and shared assignment can strengthen M3/M4 lower bounds. Check embedding of every original trip before evaluating strength.
defaults: No new default. No original business data or physical schedule constraints changed.

first_stage.tiny: Independent M3/M4 original integer enumeration, cross-trip/serial examples, duplicate-order/nonmetric/zero-duration cases
first_stage.budget: Projection and tiny verification first; no large end-to-end runs until this gate passes.

correctness_boundary: Full original solve keeps all deliveries/pickups, cross-trip use-time precedence, actual E2/E1 vehicles, stocks, turnaround and integer clocks.
A separately named lower-bound relaxation may omit coupling only after proving every full original integer schedule embeds. It never substitutes a relaxed pool proof for original exactness.
For fixed M3, every site must cover all its individual (order_id,d/p) tasks exactly once; aggregate trip count must be an upper bound on actual possible nonempty trips.
For free M4 use shared customer/site assignment z for BOTH task kinds. Never sum independent full-site bounds for every possible warehouse; that double counts incompatible assignments.
Raw projected trip sequence retains TASK IDs and every arc, including repeated customer locations. No shortcutting on nonmetric data.

Necessary earliest pickup is bounded by the same-site earliest feasible delivery+service+min_use, not actual relaxed cross-trip pickup schedules. Validate raw feasible schedules project despite this lower bound.
Certified interrupted pricing uses an actual valid global/category lower bound or conservative analytic fallback, never the best reduced-cost incumbent or restricted-master objective.
E1 cost component added only if independently valid for every original assignment; never reuse fixed-satellite bound for M4 or delivery-only raw tours that remove pickup detours on nonmetric graphs.
Scope/fingerprint binding must remain M3/M4. Do not convert to M5 to evade guards; any reused mixed-task pricing context must be independently audited as a relaxation of ORIGINAL semantics.
implementation_scope: New owned modules/files only. Reuse frozen mixed-task pricing implementation if proven compatible; preserve other M5 ongoing edits and do not modify their modules.
after_projection: Register lower-bound strength/budget experiment and then any full-kernel integration as separate candidates. Independent sources, multiple seeds and short/long shared TOTAL budgets remain mandatory for adoption.
adoption_gate: Stable audited end-to-end gain across independent sources; all proof and necessary regression checks. Mixed/negative results disabled, all retained.
stop_rules: 07:00 stop new large work;08:00 end this night only.
